name: What are the benefits of repairing cabinets instead of replacing them?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of repairing cabinets instead of replacing them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing cabinets offers several benefits over replacement, primarily cost savings and reduced disruption. Repairs are generally more affordable than purchasing and installing new cabinets. It's also a more environmentally friendly option as it extends the lifespan of existing materials. Furthermore, repairing avoids the extensive demolition and installation process associated with replacement, minimizing inconvenience to your daily routine.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing cabinets saves money, reduces disruption, and is more environmentally friendly than replacement.
